node_types.State (Blue): Pentest phase / sub-phase, or informational item (target IP, hostname, machine name, OS, ...)
node_types.Action (Orange): A concrete action the pentester performed
node_types.Finding (Green): The result/finding produced by an Action

edge_types.StateTransition (Black): State -> State, advancing through the PTT
edge_types.SearchUpdate (Green): State -> Action, starting work on a PTT item
edge_types.TrackUpdate (Blue): Action -> Finding, item execution produced findings
edge_types.Prediction (Purple): Finding -> State, findings lead back into state
